prompt:
EDIT referenced sacred Hakusan dragon image. It currently has EIGHT heads:top3,middle3,bottom2. Add exactly ONE NEW NINTH HEAD AND NECK in LOWER CENTRE foreground between existing two lower heads. Put new ninth face at xcentre and y70percent, BELOW current middle centre face, connect its neck to same body. Preserve all eight existing heads unchanged and clearly visible. Final layout THREE TOP, THREE MIDDLE, THREE LOWER = EXACTLY NINE heads and nine separate necks, not ten. No extra body/limbs. Preserve reverential expression, water, light and scales. No text/aura. Original specification: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hakusan Gongen, sacred nine-headed dragon of Taicho founding legend.
ANATOMY: ONE continuous serpentine dragon body with EXACTLY NINE distinct necks, each ends in ONE dragon head, total NINE heads [hakusan-gongen-c02]. Fan in THREE clearly separated tiers: LOWER row THREE heads, MIDDLE row THREE heads, UPPER row THREE heads, all nine faces plainly visible with dark gaps. Dragon has wet ivory and charcoal scales, small swept antlers editorial, one tail below, limbs remain underwater. No wings, not eleven heads.
MOMENT: Rise from dark mountain water toward viewer, nine necks unfurl in staggered protective fan, heads bow forward solemnly in revelation, water pours off scales. Central upper face meets viewer. No roaring attack, fire, storm magic or human victims.
POWER: Taicho founding legend reveals nine-headed dragon identifying itself with Izanami and Hakusan [hakusan-gongen-c02]. Revealed sacred form and physical water only, no elemental power inferred.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low mountain-water perspective, nine heads dominate frame arranged3+3+3withdarkgaps; full head count legible at200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Mountain Hakusan revelation context [hakusan-gongen-c01,hakusan-gongen-c02].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred protective figures remain dignified and reverential.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and centre-neck and lower-tier crops. The eight-head attempt-01 is fixed: the lower-centre ninth head is unobscured. Not mixed with the eleven-faced Kannon (c01) or the old-man form (c06). It rises from dark mountain water with waterfalls and pine cliffs under a full moon, water pouring off the scales, solemn faces bowed toward the viewer: monumental and reverent for a living Shinto/Buddhist tradition, not a rampaging monster.
